## Guide to what's in this PR

This PR is the Sprint 16 plan only. It also records your Sprint 15 decision. No game code changes, so nothing to play yet.
**Size:** 4–5 text files, about 200 lines, almost all new writing. No code, tests, screenshots or generated files.

### 🔍 Worth your look
- `docs/sprints/sprint-16-proposal.md`: the plan you're approving (same text as above). Check the five cards (Rabbit Hole, The Personal Touch, Tinkering, Aggressive Secretary, Ash 2X3ZB9CY) and the three questions: new cards in the ready-made decks, sounds, table effects.
- `docs/DECISIONS.md`: two new lines at the bottom. (1) Your Sprint 15 decision: rejected, S-15-5 kept, card-handling work paused for your research, Sprint 16 = more cards and maybe sounds and effects. (2) Which cards we picked for Sprint 16 and why. Check that the first line says what you meant.
- `docs/BACKLOG.md`: a new **"ON HOLD"** section at the top. It lists each rejected Sprint 15 story with a one-line reason, marks S-15-5 as kept, and says we won't bring back hold/drag/lift/fly work until you ask. The card lists further down now say which cards Sprint 16 takes and which wait.
